All prices are in PHP and exclusive of VAT; VAT is added on the invoice, and
payments are subject to creditable withholding (BIR Form 2307). Every line
references the internal price book [price:PB-2026-02].

| Offer | Unit | Price (PHP ex-VAT) | Inclusions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Discovery sprint | per sprint | on request [price:PB-2026-02] | scoping workshop · line audit · fixed quote |
| Inventory build | per project | from ₱480,000 [price:PB-2026-02] | barcode intake · cycle counts · reorder alerts · 60-day warranty |
| Care retainer | per month | ₱30,000 [price:PB-2026-02] | support · patches · quarterly review |

Inclusions are listed per tier; anything not listed is out of scope and is
